threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.description: Sensitive reports containing vulnerabilities and attack paths may be exposed to unauthorized users.
threats.mitigation: Access is restricted through authentication to the relevant users, and reports are delivered using short-lived pre-signed URLs with strict permissions.

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.description: A standard user may attempt to access administrative functionality.
threats.mitigation: RBAC and least-privilege IAM policies ensure that users can only perform actions aligned with their assigned roles. Users can only request to scan configurations to applications they have access to. Servers and machines on the cloud are hardened to prevent malicious commands.

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.description: An unauthorized user may attempt to impersonate a legitimate user and gain access to the system dashboard.
threats.mitigation: Authentication is enforced corporate SSO, and all anonymous access is strictly disabled. Enable MFA to users logging into the console.

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.description: A user may man in the middle an API Request in order to gain access to data in transit and tamper with data
threats.mitigation: All inputs are validated at the API layer, mTLS is used to authenticate servers and the user and to encrypt data in transit. Integration with org cloud PCA (private certficiate authority)

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.description: A user may repeatedly trigger scan requests, overwhelm the system and increase operational costs.
threats.mitigation: Rate limiting and per-user request quotas are implemented to prevent excessive usage.  Implement through cloudwatch rules to identify throttling (DDos attacks). Auto scale tasks across instances to ensure availability when workload increases

threats.title: In progress
threats.description: Data may be modified between pipeline stages, affecting analysis accuracy.

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.description: Pipeline actions may not be fully traceable.
threats.mitigation: CloudWatch logs and CloudTrail provide centralized, immutable logging of all executions.

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.description: Failures in one stage may cascade through the pipeline.
threats.mitigation: Step function orchestration enables retyr logic in the workflow as well as allows workflows to run separately in parallel distributing workflow so if one execution falis the others are not affected.

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.description: Over-permissioned Lambda functions may access restricted resources.
threats.mitigation: Each Lambda function operates under least-privilege IAM roles with strict resource scoping.

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.description: Malicious configuration input may manipulate LLM behaviour and outputs.
threats.mitigation: Bedrock has built in guardrails to deny specific requests. System prompt can further give it context to deny specific requests.

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.description: Sensitive infrastructure data may be exposed to the LLM
threats.mitigation: Nature of the issue. Outbound security group rules on Bedrock will be very restrictive to prevent data exfiltration. Tool use will be limited.

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.description: Large inputs may cause excessive token usage or service throttling.
threats.mitigation: Input size limits and chunking mechanisms are enforced embedding models encodes data and stores it in Amazon OpenSearch for easy ingestion for the model. (semantic search to answer questions).

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.description: The AI component may attempt to access sensitive credentials if compromised or manipulated.
threats.mitigation: Lambda functions acts as a secure intermediary between AI components and Secrets Manager, enforcing strict access control and preventing direct secret retrieval.

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.description: Stored reports or configurations may be modified after writing.
threats.mitigation: S3 versioning is enabled, and Object Lock can enforce immutability for critical data.

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.description: Unauthorized modifications may go undetected. Writing to s3 may be done by unauthorized users
threats.mitigation: CloudTrail data events and S3 access logs provide full auditability.

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.description: Sensitive reports may be exposed.
threats.mitigation: Data is encrypted using KMS and access is restricted via IAM

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.description: Excessive data storage may lead to cost or performance issues.
threats.mitigation: Lifecycle policies automatically remove outdated reports and configs and monitor storage growth.

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.description: External systems may be impersonated.
threats.mitigation: Secure authentication through TLS and restricted network routing (configured by end-user ensure only trusted endpoints are used

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.description: Data may be altered in transit.
threats.mitigation: End-to-end TLS encryption with certificate validation is enforced.

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.description: Sensitive data may be exposed during transmission.
threats.mitigation: All communication is secured using HTTPS encryption.

threats.title: New STRIDE threat
threats.description: External API endpoints may become unavailable.
threats.mitigation: Monitoring and alerting systems are in place with escalation procedures for failures. Email users when API endpoints are no longer accessible
